tier: Not published (the wiki's tier list is an image). category = wiki group heading.
availability_note: Abilities are offered at chapter start (Glory talent), after each hero level-up (choice of 3), and from angels, the lucky wheel, Masters Blessing and The Devil.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.effect: Fires one extra arrow at the same time; -10% base damage and -15% attack speed.
abilities.note: Extra Multishots can come from The Devil.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.effect: Arrows bounce up to 3 times between nearby enemies; damage -30% per ricochet.
abilities.stacking: Not stated; ability page says a shot can hit 3 times in total.

abilities.name: Front Arrow + 1
abilities.effect: Fires one extra projectile forward; -25% base damage.
abilities.stacking: Can be chosen only once per game (ability page).

abilities.name: Piercing Shot
abilities.effect: Projectiles pass through enemies; -33% damage after each enemy.

abilities.name: Bouncy Wall
abilities.effect: Projectiles bounce off walls; -50% damage after a bounce.

abilities.name: Diagonal Arrows +1
abilities.effect: Fires one extra projectile diagonally forward left and right.
abilities.stacking: Multiple copies can be stacked (ability page advice for Staff builds).

abilities.name: Side Arrows + 1
abilities.effect: Fires one extra projectile to the left and right.

abilities.name: Rear Arrow + 1
abilities.effect: Fires one extra projectile backwards.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.effect: Lightning: when an enemy is hit, bolts strike nearby enemies for 25% of equipment damage (scaled by modifiers such as attack boosts).
abilities.stacking: Max one spark per enemy per tick (table note).

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.effect: Freezes an enemy for up to 2 s; the next hit unfreezes it. Each freeze hit adds 10% modifiable damage.
abilities.stacking: Re-hitting a frozen enemy unfreezes it; no stacking stated.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.effect: Poison: 35% of equipment damage per second until the enemy dies.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.effect: Burn: 18% of damage every 0.25 s, up to 7 ticks (2 s); timer resets on each hit.
abilities.note: Wiki gives base damage in one section and equipment damage in the table (inconsistent).

abilities.name: Element Upgrade
abilities.effect: Element damage increased greatly; various elemental stats.
abilities.note: Effect row blank on wiki; description used.

abilities.name: Element Burst
abilities.effect: Various elemental stats; elemental damage can crit.
abilities.note: Effect row blank on wiki; description used.

abilities.name: Dark Touch
abilities.effect: Shot enemy gets a debuff that explodes after 1 s for 90% of total bonus damage to surrounding enemies (base damage does not apply).
abilities.stacking: Multiple darks do not stack on one enemy.

abilities.name: Chilling Blast
abilities.effect: Killed enemies explode in ice for an AoE Freeze (no damage; can trigger headshot).

abilities.name: Death Bomb
abilities.effect: Killed enemies explode for 100% of equipment damage in an AoE.

abilities.name: Death Nova
abilities.effect: Killed enemies fire projectiles in 8 directions for 30% of current damage on contact.

abilities.name: Attack Boost (Major)
abilities.effect: +30% of base damage.
abilities.stacking: Additive with other boosts; source example: a second boost goes 1.3x to 1.6x (+23%).

abilities.name: Attack Boost (Minor)
abilities.effect: +15% of base damage.

abilities.name: Attack Speed Boost (Major)
abilities.effect: +25% of base attack speed.

abilities.name: Attack Speed Boost (Minor)
abilities.effect: +12.5% of base attack speed.

abilities.name: Crit Master
abilities.effect: +10% crit chance and +40% crit damage.
abilities.stacking: Gets stronger with more copies (source example: 2nd copy +28% DPS vs +20% for the first).

abilities.name: Crit Master (Minor)
abilities.effect: +5% crit chance and +20% crit damage.

abilities.name: HP Plus
abilities.effect: +2.2% max HP per room cleared without taking damage.
abilities.note: Dodging an attack does not count as being hit.

abilities.name: Attack Plus
abilities.effect: +2.25% attack per room cleared without damage.
abilities.note: Dodging does not count as being hit.

abilities.name: Crit Plus
abilities.effect: +1.42% crit chance per room cleared without damage.
abilities.stacking: Up to 18 times; max +25.6% crit chance.
abilities.note: Dodging does not count as being hit.

abilities.name: Speed Plus
abilities.effect: +1.87% speed per room cleared without damage.
abilities.note: Dodging does not count as being hit.

abilities.name: HP Gain Aura
abilities.effect: Increases health once in a while; no values published.
abilities.note: No details on wiki.

abilities.name: Speed Aura
abilities.effect: Speed +~62.5% for 2 s; 8 s cooldown.
abilities.note: Best used right after entering a new room.

abilities.name: Crit Aura
abilities.effect: Crit chance +~47.5% for 2 s; 8 s cooldown.
abilities.note: Best used right after entering a new room.

abilities.name: Invincibility Star
abilities.effect: Invincible for 2 s every 10 s.

abilities.name: Shield Guard
abilities.effect: Two shields rotate around the player and block projectiles.

abilities.name: HP Boost
abilities.effect: +20% of base max HP.

abilities.name: Strong Heart
abilities.effect: Heart heal power +40% and heart drop rate increased.
abilities.note: Does not increase Bloodthirst.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.effect: Restores 40% of health.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.effect: Gain 1.5% of base HP on each enemy kill.

abilities.name: Wingman
abilities.effect: Pets block projectiles for you.

abilities.name: Spirit Front Arrow
abilities.effect: Spirit fires one extra parallel projectile (-25% damage).
abilities.note: Wiki shows a 1.4.8 hero attack/crit line in some cells; alignment unclear.

abilities.name: Spirit Multi-shot
abilities.effect: Spirit fires one extra projectile (-10% damage, -15% attack speed).

abilities.name: Spirit Diagonal Arrow +1
abilities.effect: Spirit fires one extra projectile diagonally forward left and right.

abilities.name: Spirit Attack Speed Boost
abilities.effect: Spirit attack speed +20%; hero attack speed +15%.
abilities.note: Removed in 1.3.6 (wiki).

abilities.name: Spirit Crit Boost
abilities.effect: Spirit crit chance +20%; hero crit chance +5%; hero crit damage +20%.
abilities.note: Removed in 1.3.6 (wiki).

abilities.name: Spirit Attack Boost
abilities.effect: Pet damage +100%; hero damage +15% (table). Ability page says hero damage +10% sometimes.
abilities.note: Removed in 1.3.6 (wiki). Table and page disagree.

abilities.name: Spirit - Blaze
abilities.effect: Pet attacks apply pet flame; table lines give hero ATK +22% and a +10% attack line (cell layout unclear).

abilities.name: Spirit - Freeze
abilities.effect: Pet attacks apply freeze; table lines give hero crit damage +20% and attack speed +18%.

abilities.name: Spirit - Poisoned Touch
abilities.effect: Pet attacks apply pet poison; table lines give hero crit damage +20% and HP +15%.

abilities.name: Spirit - Bolt
abilities.effect: Pet attacks apply pet bolt; table lines give hero crit chance +5%, crit damage +15%, crit rate +3%.

abilities.name: Fire Circle
abilities.effect: Two flame orbs orbit the player; 75% of current damage plus Blaze.

abilities.name: Ice Circle
abilities.effect: Two ice orbs orbit the player; 75% of current damage plus Freeze.

abilities.name: Poison Circle
abilities.effect: Two poison orbs orbit the player; 75% of current damage plus Poison Touch.

abilities.name: Bolt Circle
abilities.effect: Two lightning orbs orbit the player; 75% of current damage plus Bolt.
abilities.note: Base damage does not affect this ability.

abilities.name: Obsidian Circle
abilities.effect: Two dark orbs; the debuff explodes after 1 s for 90% of total bonus damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.stacking: Multiple darks do not stack on one enemy.

abilities.name: Blazing Strike
abilities.effect: Summons a fire sword that fires for 150% of current damage with Blaze.
abilities.note: Does not spawn if you are too far.

abilities.name: Frost Strike
abilities.effect: Summons a frost sword that fires for 150% of current damage with Freeze.
abilities.note: Does not spawn if you are too far.

abilities.name: Toxic Strike
abilities.effect: Summons a toxic sword that fires for 150% of current damage with Poison Touch.
abilities.note: Does not spawn if you are too far.

abilities.name: Bolt Strike
abilities.effect: Summons a bolt sword that fires for 150% of current damage with Bolt.
abilities.note: Does not spawn if you are too far.

abilities.name: Fire Sword
abilities.effect: Summons 2 fire swords spinning around you; hits for 100% of current damage with Blaze.

abilities.name: Ice Sword
abilities.effect: Summons 2 ice swords spinning around you; hits for 100% of current damage with Freeze.

abilities.name: Poison Sword
abilities.effect: Summons 2 poison swords spinning around you; hits for 100% of current damage with Poison Touch.

abilities.name: Bolt Swords
abilities.effect: Summons 2 bolt swords spinning around you; hits for 100% of current damage with Bolt.

abilities.name: Blazing Star
abilities.effect: Drops a star on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Blaze.
abilities.note: Higher spawn chance per attack than meteor, smaller area.

abilities.name: Frost Star
abilities.effect: Drops a star on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Freeze.
abilities.note: Higher spawn chance per attack than meteor, smaller area.

abilities.name: Toxic Star
abilities.effect: Drops a star on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Poison Touch.
abilities.note: Higher spawn chance per attack than meteor, smaller area.

abilities.name: Bolt Star
abilities.effect: Drops a star on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Bolt.
abilities.note: Higher spawn chance per attack than meteor, smaller area.

abilities.name: Blazing Meteor
abilities.effect: Drops a meteor on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Blaze.
abilities.note: Lower spawn chance per attack than star, larger area.

abilities.name: Frost Meteor
abilities.effect: Drops a meteor on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Freeze.
abilities.note: Lower spawn chance per attack than star, larger area. Freeze damage added in 1.4.8.

abilities.name: Toxic Meteor
abilities.effect: Drops a meteor on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Poison Touch.
abilities.note: Lower spawn chance per attack than star, larger area.

abilities.name: Bolt Meteor
abilities.effect: Drops a meteor on enemies: 200% of current damage on hit with Bolt.
abilities.note: Lower spawn chance per attack than star, larger area.

abilities.name: Fury
abilities.effect: +0.4% attack speed per 1% missing HP.
abilities.stacking: Unknown whether additive or multiplicative (wiki note).

abilities.name: Fury (Helix)
abilities.effect: Helix's stronger version: +1.2% damage per 1% HP lost (Helix page).

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.effect: Damage increased by the percentage of missing HP.
abilities.stacking: Multiplicative (wiki); example: 10 of 1000 HP left gives +99% damage (ability page).

abilities.name: Grace
abilities.effect: +0.6% healing from hearts per 1% missing HP.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.effect: +0.3% dodge per 1% missing HP.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.effect: 12.5% chance to instantly kill a monster.
abilities.note: Ricochet, pierce and spirit shots can all trigger it.

abilities.name: Smart
abilities.effect: +30% XP; max level +2.

abilities.name: Greed
abilities.effect: Coin drop chance +25%; enemy damage +20%.

abilities.name: Overdraft
abilities.effect: Attack speed +45%; XP gain -20%.

abilities.name: Holy Touch
abilities.effect: Arrows that connect fire two perpendicular projectiles dealing 60% of current damage each (Holy effect).

abilities.name: Strong Strong Heart
abilities.effect: +2% attack speed per crystal heart, max 60%.
abilities.note: Name as printed on the wiki table; requires Strong Heart.

abilities.name: Dodge Master
abilities.effect: Dodge chance +20%.

abilities.name: Extra Life
abilities.effect: Revives you once at 100% HP when killed (not an invincibility like gem or ad revive).
abilities.unlock: The Devil only; costs 30% of max base HP (ability page).

abilities.name: Slow Projectile
abilities.effect: Slows enemy projectiles.

abilities.name: Shadow Clone
abilities.effect: Summons a shadow clone that fires arrows at 100% of equipment damage per second.
abilities.note: Chance is per attack since 1.4.8.

abilities.name: Summon One-Eyed Bat
abilities.effect: Summons a bat that fires lasers at 100% of equipment damage per second.
abilities.note: Chance is per attack since 1.4.8.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.effect: Attack speed +25%; the effect doubles once an enemy is killed.

abilities.name: Water Walker
abilities.effect: Walk across water; hero damage +15%.

abilities.name: Through The Wall
abilities.effect: Walk through walls; hero damage +15%.

abilities.name: Giant
abilities.effect: Transform into a giant: damage +40% and max HP +5% (1.4.8).

abilities.name: Dwarf
abilities.effect: Transform into a smaller body: crit rate +10%.
